title.text: Can it be missing or can it fail?

runs.text: Place each job according to what it has to give back: a value that may be missing, or a value that may fail with a reason.
When not finding something is normal and there is nothing to explain, an optional is enough:
. When you have to say what went wrong, you need a result:
Look up a contact who may not be in the contact list.
Find the first even number of a list.
Turn a text into a number saying why it failed.
Divide, with a warning if the divisor is 0.
